text: Allah timminiri tagugol kammuuli ɗin, e nder balɗe ɗiɗi: woni Alkamisa e Juma; ko e ɗen balɗe ɗiɗi, woni tagugol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, timmiri balɗe jeegoo. Ontuma Allah yamiri kammu kalal, fiyaaku maggu, immorde e yamaruyee ɗoftagol Mo rewa Mo. Men cuɗiniri kammu aduna ngun, koode, Men reeni ngu e ko seytanuuji ɗin wujjata heɗoo kon. Ko jantaa koo fow, ko eɓɓoore Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Annduɗo fii tagu Makko ngun.
